> **Verdict: Real skill gain** · Confidence: High · Injury overlap: No

Drew Rasmussen improved in 2026 by expanding his out-of-zone chase rate and missing more bats, driven primarily by re-introducing a highly effective changeup into his starting mix [Q7, Q13]. While maintaining identical main fastball velocity (95.8 mph in both 2025 and 2026, z = 0.4), Rasmussen raised his strikeout rate from 21.7% to 26.0% (z = 1.8) and trimmed his walk rate from 6.3% to 4.8% (z = -1.2) [Q1, Q8]. Coinciding with the pitch mix evolution, he suppressed contact quality, dropping average exit velocity allowed from 90.0 mph to 87.6 mph (z = -2.4) and hard-hit rate from 43.3% to 33.8% [Q1, Q17]. This skill jump closed the gap between his surface ERA (2.67 down from 2.76) and his underlying FIP (2.82 down from 3.84) [Q5, Q14].

## What changed in the pitches

The key pitch mix evolution in 2026 was the resurgence of Rasmussen's changeup, which jumped from 1.2% usage (28 pitches) in 2025 to 13.3% usage (354 pitches) in 2026 [Q7, Q18]. The offspeed offering averaged 89.6 mph with -11.8 inches of horizontal break and 2.5 inches of induced vertical break, generating a 35.3% whiff rate, 39.0% chase rate, and .193 xwOBA while accounting for +6.2 runs of value [Q7, Q18, Q21, Q22].

To integrate the changeup, Rasmussen reduced four-seam fastball usage from 35.2% to 28.0% and cutter usage from 31.4% to 28.9% [Q7, Q18]. Four-seamer velocity remained identical at 95.8 mph, but throwing it out of the strike zone more frequently (zone rate dropped from 58.5% to 51.7%) helped drive its chase rate from 30.7% to 38.9% and whiff rate from 23.2% to 26.4% [Q7, Q18]. Sinker usage remained consistent (22.9% in 2025 to 23.8% in 2026) while gaining horizontal sweep (-14.4 to -16.5 inches), leading to a jump in sinker run value from +4.4 to +16.5 runs [Q7, Q18, Q21]. Overall zone percentage fell from 53.3% to 49.7% (z = -2.5), which coincided with total chase rate rising from 28.7% to 33.1% (z = 2.4) [Q1].

## Skill vs. luck

Rasmussen's gains were backed by underlying skill changes across the board:

* Strikeout rate climbed from 21.7% to 26.0% (z = 1.8) [Q1].
* Whiff rate rose from 22.2% to 25.1% (z = 1.7) [Q1].
* Walk rate dropped from 6.3% to 4.8% (z = -1.2) [Q1].
* xwOBA improved from .291 to .271 (z = -1.1), tracking his wOBA shift from .277 to .251 (z = -1.0) [Q1].
* BABIP remained stable, moving slightly from .246 to .251 (z = 0.2) [Q1].

In 2025, Rasmussen outperformed his 3.84 FIP with a 2.76 ERA despite allowing an 18.8% HR/FB rate [Q4, Q5, Q17]. In 2026, improved strikeout, walk, and home run rates brought his 2.82 FIP in line with his 2.67 ERA, while HR/FB dropped to 13.1% [Q5, Q17]. Overall run value expanded from +24.5 to +40.9 runs [Q17].

## Health and workload

Rasmussen completed both seasons without an injured list stint, having last missed time on the 60-day IL in 2024 following right elbow surgery [Q12]. As a full-time rotation anchor, he expanded his workload from 150.0 IP across 31 starts in 2025 to 172.0 IP across 30 starts in 2026 [Q11, Q14]. 

His arm slot dropped slightly between seasons: average release height decreased from 5.93 ft to 5.85 ft, release extension shifted from 6.59 ft to 6.50 ft, and arm angle moved from 54.9° to 52.4° [Q20]. It is possible this lower arm angle facilitated better feel for his changeup or added horizontal movement to his sinker, though a direct causal mechanism cannot be proven from tracking data alone.

## Career and league context

Across his career starting in 2021, Rasmussen maintained surface ERAs between 2.62 and 2.84 [Q5]. However, 2026 represented his most complete underlying statistical profile, pairing elite run-value output (+40.9 runs) with single-digit walk rates and an elevated strikeout frequency [Q4, Q17, Q19].

## What the data can't tell us

Because barrel percentage is not available in the database, contact quality must be evaluated through exit velocity and hard-hit rates rather than barrel classification metrics. Additionally, pitch tracking data alone cannot determine whether the minor arm angle reduction was an intentional mechanical adjustment or a natural byproduct of workload expansion.

## Next questions

* Did the changeup's effectiveness hold up equally against right-handed and left-handed batters?
* How did Rasmussen's pitch sequencing change in two-strike counts after introducing the changeup?
* Did the lower arm angle alter the vertical or horizontal movement profiles on his cutter and sweeper?

args.sql:
SELECT
  season,
  COUNT(DISTINCT game_pk) as g,
  COUNT(*) as pitches,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home','pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b','stolen_base_2b','wild_pitch','passed_ball','truncated_pa') THEN 1 END) as bf,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_speed END) as avg_exit_velo,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_angle END) as avg_launch_angle,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) as hard_hit_pct,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) as balls_in_play,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) as bip_count,
  AVG(woba_value) / AVG(woba_denom) as woba,
  AVG(CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN estimated_woba_using_speedangle ELSE woba_value END END) / AVG(woba_denom) as xwoba,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND bb_type != 'popup' THEN babip_value END) as babip, -- or standard babip calculation
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bb_type = 'fly_ball' THEN 1 END), 0) as hr_per_fb,
  SUM(-delta_run_exp) as run_value_total
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season

SELECT 
    season,
    pitch_type,
    COUNT(*) as pitches,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY season), 3) as usage_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(release_speed), 1) as avg_velo,
    ROUND(AVG(release_spin_rate), 0) as avg_spin,
    ROUND(AVG(pfx_x_in), 1) as avg_hbreak,
    ROUND(AVG(pfx_z_in), 1) as avg_ivb,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN in_zone THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) as zone_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_whiff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_swing THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) as whiff_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_chase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) as chase_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_csw THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 3) as csw_pct
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season, pitch_type
ORDER BY season, pitches DESC

               FROM pitches
               WHERE pitcher = ? AND (game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE OR game_date BETWEEN ?::DATE AND ?::DATE)),
    long AS (SELECT 'k_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',
         'stolen_base_2b','stolen_base_3b','stolen_base_home','wild_pitch','passed_ball',
         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'bb_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('walk','intent_walk')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',

        UNION ALL SELECT 'hr_per_bf' AS stat, period, CAST((events = 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',
         'pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b',
         'pickoff_caught_stealing_2b','pickoff_caught_stealing_3b','pickoff_caught_stealing_home',

         'other_advance','truncated_pa'))
        UNION ALL SELECT 'whiff_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_whiff) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE is_swing
        UNION ALL SELECT 'chase_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_chase) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14
        UNION ALL SELECT 'zone_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((in_zone) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'csw_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_csw) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'xwoba' AS stat, period, CAST((CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN
        CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN coalesce(estimated_woba_using_speedangle, woba_value)
             ELSE woba_value END END) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'woba' AS stat, period, CAST((woba_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'babip' AS stat, period, CAST((babip_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run' AND babip_value IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT 'exit_velo' AS stat, period, CAST((launch_speed) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND launch_speed IS NOT NULL),
    games AS (SELECT period, game_pk, avg(release_speed) AS v, count(*) AS c FROM p
              WHERE release_speed IS NOT NULL AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY period, game_pk),
    s AS (SELECT stat, period, avg(v) AS mean, coalesce(var_samp(v), 0) AS variance, count(v) AS n

    SELECT a.stat, a.mean AS period_a, b.mean AS period_b, b.mean - a.mean AS change, a.n AS n_a, b.n AS n_b,
           round((b.mean - a.mean) / nullif(sqrt(a.variance / a.n + b.variance / b.n), 0), 1) AS z

    CAST(sum(babip_value) FILTER (WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run' AND babip_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS babip,

Q17.purpose: Drew Rasmussen quality of contact, BABIP, HR/FB, wOBA, xwOBA, exit velo, launch angle, hard hit% for 2025 vs 2026
Q17.sql:
SELECT
  season,
  COUNT(DISTINCT game_pk) as g,
  COUNT(*) as pitches,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home','pickoff_1b','pickoff_2b','pickoff_3b','stolen_base_2b','wild_pitch','passed_ball','truncated_pa') THEN 1 END) as bf,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_speed END) as avg_exit_velo,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_angle END) as avg_launch_angle,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END) as hard_hit_pct,

  AVG(woba_value) / AVG(woba_denom) as woba,
  AVG(CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN estimated_woba_using_speedangle ELSE woba_value END END) / AVG(woba_denom) as xwoba,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND bb_type != 'popup' THEN babip_value END) as babip, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bb_type = 'fly_ball' THEN 1 END), 0) as hr_per_fb,
  SUM(-delta_run_exp) as run_value_total
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season
ORDER BY season

    long AS (SELECT 'k_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('strikeout','strikeout_double_play')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',

        UNION ALL SELECT 'bb_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((events IN ('walk','intent_walk')) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN
        ('caught_stealing_2b','caught_stealing_3b','caught_stealing_home',

        UNION ALL SELECT 'hr_per_bf' AS stat, period, CAST((events = 'home_run') AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE (events IS NOT NULL AND events NOT IN

        UNION ALL SELECT 'whiff_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_whiff) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE is_swing
        UNION ALL SELECT 'chase_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_chase) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE zone BETWEEN 11 AND 14
        UNION ALL SELECT 'zone_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((in_zone) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'csw_pct' AS stat, period, CAST((is_csw) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE TRUE
        UNION ALL SELECT 'xwoba' AS stat, period, CAST((CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN
        CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN coalesce(estimated_woba_using_speedangle, woba_value)
             ELSE woba_value END END) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'woba' AS stat, period, CAST((woba_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE woba_denom = 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 'babip' AS stat, period, CAST((babip_value) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND events <> 'home_run' AND babip_value IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL SELECT 'exit_velo' AS stat, period, CAST((launch_speed) AS DOUBLE) AS v FROM p WHERE type = 'X' AND launch_speed IS NOT NULL),
    games AS (SELECT period, game_pk, avg(release_speed) AS v, count(*) AS c FROM p
              WHERE release_speed IS NOT NULL AND pitch_type = (SELECT pitch_type FROM pitches WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND pitch_type IN ('FF', 'SI', 'FC') GROUP BY pitch_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY period, game_pk),
    s AS (SELECT stat, period, avg(v) AS mean, coalesce(var_samp(v), 0) AS variance, count(v) AS n
          FROM long GROUP BY stat, period
          UNION ALL
          
          SELECT 'main_fb_velo', period, sum(v * c) / sum(c), coalesce(var_samp(v), 0), count(*) FROM games GROUP BY period)
    SELECT a.stat, a.mean AS period_a, b.mean AS period_b, b.mean - a.mean AS change, a.n AS n_a, b.n AS n_b,
           round((b.mean - a.mean) / nullif(sqrt(a.variance / a.n + b.variance / b.n), 0), 1) AS z
    FROM s a JOIN s b ON a.stat = b.stat AND a.period = 'A' AND b.period = 'B'
    ORDER BY abs(z) DESC NULLS LAST

Q25.purpose: Drew Rasmussen pitch type contact stats 2025 vs 2026
Q25.sql:
SELECT
  season,
  pitch_type,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_speed END) as avg_exit_velo,
  AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN launch_angle END) as avg_launch_angle,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' AND launch_speed >= 95 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN 1 END), 0) as hard_hit_pct,
  AVG(woba_value) / NULLIF(AVG(woba_denom), 0) as woba,
  AVG(CASE WHEN woba_denom = 1 THEN CASE WHEN type = 'X' THEN estimated_woba_using_speedangle ELSE woba_value END END) / NULLIF(AVG(woba_denom), 0) as xwoba,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN events = 'home_run' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN bb_type = 'fly_ball' THEN 1 END), 0) as hr_per_fb,
  SUM(-delta_run_exp) as run_value_total
FROM pitches
WHERE pitcher = 656876 AND season IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY season, pitch_type
ORDER BY pitch_type, season
